# Pinned legacy oracle

`oracle.json` contains synthetic expected results generated by executing the
legacy renderer and URL helpers from Kandev source
`15495808e383c0af926a617b54cd8b2adacd9db3`. The `Sources` object records the
original SHA-256 of each source before adaptation. The generator changes only
the internal weburl import path to compile the isolated, dependency-free module.
The repository's MIT license applies to the original Kandev source.

Regenerate with an explicitly selected checkout containing that commit:

```sh
node scripts/generate-legacy-oracle.mjs "$KANDEV_SOURCE"
```

The script performs no fetch and disables Go module network resolution. It
creates an ignored temporary module, runs `generate.go` against the pinned
source, writes the fixture, and removes temporary source and binaries. Ordinary
tests read the committed fixture without a source checkout or legacy runtime.

The 38 rendering cases cover the four legacy events, update variants, missing
values/origin, literal injection, escaping, unknown variables/events, and input
and output bounds. Six URL cases cover encoding, missing IDs, loopback origins,
and invalid origins or credential-bearing release URLs. These are text/URL
parity checks; host ownership, session association, and dispatch require their
separate integration tests.
